content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy. Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide range of loads, from about 5 to 30 reps per set, as long as your sets get close to failure (roughly 0-3 reps left in the tank). Heavy loads in the 5-10 rep range are time-efficient, and they matter for your 100 kg bench goal because strength is specific to the load you practice. So build muscle with moderate reps and keep some heavy bench work in the mix. 💪
